<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/sigmafi/bonds"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Bonds not yet repaid or liquidated, soonest maturity first. Only verified bonds unless `all` is true: a verified bond is the one its bond asset's genesis order created. Anyone can build a bond naming any asset, and such a bond only ever pays that asset's holder.
